Florida Homeowners Insurance Rates: What to Expect in 2026

May 22, 2026 · HOInsurance.com

Why Are Florida Homeowners Insurance Rates So High?

Florida homeowners face some of the highest insurance rates in the nation due to unique risks like hurricanes, sinkholes, and increased litigation. In 2025, the average annual premium reached $4,200—nearly triple the national average. With climate change intensifying storms, rates are projected to rise another 10-15% in 2026.

Key Factors Driving Your Premium

  • Roof age: Homes with roofs older than 10 years pay up to 40% more
  • Flood risk: 1.7 million Florida properties are in FEMA flood zones
  • Claims history: Just one claim can increase premiums by 20%

How to Save on Coverage

Bundle with Florida auto insurance for multi-policy discounts, or consider working with specialty providers like Tomlinson & Co for high-risk properties. Always compare quotes annually—we've saved clients an average of $1,200/year.
